title: Review saturated orbit depth visualization fix

Review examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py for correctness of default 1st/99th percentile visualization bounds, explicit min/max override behavior, sampling behavior, validation, and raw .npy preservation.
Review tests and docs for consistency with the new behavior and CLI options.
Run focused non-simulator validation: py_compile, unittest, helper smoke checks, and git diff --check.
